title: Audit-log-exporter: private deployment sinks + retention defaults and installer wiring
description:
Motivation: private (VPC/on-prem) deployments need a hardened, auditable export path for platform and control-plane events. This PR wires audit-log-exporter sinks and retention defaults into the private installer (Helm + Terraform modules) so customers get secure export to supported sinks by default and operators can override retention/policy easily.

Summary of changes:
- Add `private` sink config block and default retention profiles (30d/90d/365d) with KMS and HSM-aware encryption settings.
- Expose sink parameters via Helm values.yaml and map them into the redwood-private-installer Terraform module.
- Add RBAC changes to installer to allow audit-log-exporter to read/write to sink resources in air-gapped and VPC setups.
- Add a new Helm chart values schema and validation checks to prevent misconfiguration in HA/private modes.
- Integration tests: e2e smoke test that deploys the private installer with ephemeral GCS/S3/HTTP sinks (mocks) and validates encryption, delivery, and retention enforcement.
- Docs: update private-deployments/observability.md with configuration examples and recommended defaults.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for new config parsing and validation
- [x] Integration e2e smoke test (CI job)
- [x] Helm values schema and README examples
- [x] Terraform module mapping and variable docs
- [x] Security review for RBAC and KMS usage

Related linear/jira: ENG-3124, SEC-117, PM-824.

Notes on rollout and backward compatibility: default retention is opt-out for private installs to meet common compliance postures; installers that previously supplied custom sink configs will continue to work. The Helm schema validation will fail deployments with ambiguous sink+retention combos; this is intentional to avoid silent misconfigurations.

Manual testing instructions (summary): deploy `redwood-private-installer` chart with `values.privateAudit.enabled=true` and `values.privateAudit.sinks[0]` pointing to a test S3/GCS endpoint. Verify events appear in sink mock, confirm retention TTL metadata is set, and ensure audit-log-exporter pod logs show successful delivery and KMS envelope encryption.

Security & compliance: uses envelope encryption with customer-managed keys where provided; RBAC tightened to least privilege for sink writers.
